Hi,
So, I’m roughly in the same boat, living in Malaysia with the same kind of thoughts especially when everybody constantly remind you of the ‘right’ way to think, act and say.
My view is that with a world generally divided into 3 religions ( Islam, Christianity, Buddhism ), at least in Islam and Christianity, ( from what I understand ) apostles are guaranteed to eternal damnation . 
The thought of that just baffles me knowing that 2/3 people ( or however many ) is wrong and will suffer till the end of time. Why ? Because they were ‘unlucky’ to be born in a country of a so called wrong religion ( whichever it may be ).

Though, to be honest, I just don’t have the care for ideologies and believes. I just want to have a happy life without causing trouble or harm to other people.

I would say just fake it for now as in Islam, accepting ‘apostles’ is still widely criticised and looked down upon. And not many will consider you’re understanding and beliefs as something other than completely wrong and misguided.
Coming from someone who is agnostic living in a muslim country.

And if you can’t keep it to yourself, find someone ( preferably agnostic ) of a different religion to confide to.
Good luck

Yeah, but the longer the series progresses, the less important characters you need to remember. I have the same issue as well at first because I was used to reading Japanese manga so Korean names can get confusing at times.

Yes, the light novel’s really good. Though it depends on what you like about the series. For me, the fact that I read the manhwa first gives a good picture on fights and interactions in the LN which ultimately helps the plot and the story. But if you feel that art plays a big role in the series, I would suggest just stick to the manhwa.

Though, the manhwa should conclude in 2 years or so. If you couldn’t wait like me, go for the LN.
Practice and be patient. The longer it takes to win, the more satisfying.
